blocklist.title: Event blocklist
blocklist.intro1: Adding a user to an event blocklist hides that event from them (only users who have not registered are blocked; registered users retain access to preserve their history).
blocklist.intro2: Blocked users cannot see the event from the home page, calendar, search, shared links, or any other entry point.
blocklist.intro3: All actions are recorded in an audit trail (who added the user, when, and why).
